subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The tone of his voice seemed to ______ that he knew more than he was letting on.
solution:
The correct answer is: **imply.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"imply"** means to suggest or indicate something indirectly. (संकेत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **His tone seemed to imply that he was unhappy with the decision.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word "imply" fits best in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Incise** (काटना): To cut into a surface.

 
 
• **Example:** The surgeon had to incise the tissue to reach the affected area.
 
 
 
• **Intent** (इरादा): A purpose or intention.
 
 
• **Example:** His intent was clear when he started the project.
 
 
 
• **Inculcate** (सिखाना): To instill an idea or habit by persistent instruction.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher aimed to inculcate good study habits in her students.
